spans.s: --dried cow dung placed on the head of afflicted children to remove evils; an ancient यादव practice. Vi.

: Br. III. १३. १९; IV. ४४. ९६.
Swallowed by sea, the sages left to the Sahya hill and reported of the erosion to राम on the Mahendra hill. Addressed by them, राम appealed to वरुण who at first did not turn up. When he grew wroth, वरुण promised to give back the land.
3: Ib. III. ५६. 7-५६; ५७. १२ to the end and ch. ५८. whole.
Here Yama per- formed penance and became a लोकपाल and lord of पितृस्; sacred to पितृस्.
4: M. ११. १८-20; २२. ३८.
Sacred to भद्रकर्णिका;
5: M. १३. ३०; १८१. २५.
a sacred place for the performance of श्राद्ध; nearby is the R. ताम्रपर्णी; sacred to शन्कर.
6: वा. ४८. ३०; ७७. १९-21.
(II)--the avatar of the १६थ् dva1para in the holy गोकर्ण vana with four sons. वा. २३. १७२.
(III)--a ऋत्विक् at the sacrifice of ब्रह्मा. वा. १०६. ३९.
(IV)--a measurement by the ring finger. Br.
--R. in भारतवर्ष; trembled at हिरण्- यकशिपु's reign. M. १६३. ६३.
